adjudication_policy: Normalize labeler concepts by concept_id and semantic equivalence before comparing lists.
For two-to-one categorical splits, adjudicate using GOLD_RUBRIC and cases.json facts.
For three-way categorical disagreement or unresolved substantive critical-invariant disagreement, mark tier gold_uncertain because no human review is available.
Raw invariant-set differences caused by broad versus narrow inclusion are recorded but not treated as substantive unresolved invariant conflicts unless they change a critical safety requirement.
